title: Smooth and stable Euler implosions
summary: We construct a new class of self-similar implosion profiles for the multi-dimensional compressible Euler equations. These profiles are smooth, genuinely non-isentropic, radially/spherically symmetric, and have explicit (closed-form) similarity exponents. We prove that the exact Euler solution corresponding to the ground state implosion profile is stable to radially symmetric perturbations, as a solution to the full nonlinear compressible Euler equations, modulo a one-dimensional compatibility condition on the initial data.
